categories.label: Breakout today
categories.meaning: Closed above its closing trigger (the last confirmed swing high) today with higher highs and higher lows. Plan: buy at the next open only if it opens inside the entry band.

categories.label: Ready to break
categories.meaning: Rising structure (higher highs + higher lows) and the close is within 1 ATR of the trigger. Plan: buy only after a daily CLOSE above the trigger.

categories.label: Uptrend - wait
categories.meaning: Rising structure, but price is not near a fresh trigger. Holders trail the stop; new buyers wait for the trigger close or a dip to support.

categories.label: Turning up
categories.meaning: Mixed structure but trend indicators have turned up. Not a buy yet: it needs a higher low and a close above the trigger.

categories.label: Sideways / no trend
categories.meaning: No clear direction. Stay out until price closes above the trigger (bullish) or below the structure exit (bearish).

categories.label: Structure exit today
categories.meaning: Closed below its last confirmed swing low TODAY. Longs exit at the next open. Bearish trades only through F&O (no overnight short in cash).

categories.label: Below structure
categories.meaning: Already broke its last swing low on an earlier day and has not repaired. Avoid buying; wait for a new higher low.

categories.label: Downtrend
categories.meaning: Lower highs and lower lows. Avoid buying; bounces into resistance are selling zones for F&O traders.

categories.label: Data check
categories.meaning: Incomplete or suspect price data for this session, so no plan is shown.

supertrend.name: Supertrend (10, 3)
supertrend.how: Green line under price = uptrend; red line above price = downtrend. A close through the line flips it.

adx.name: ADX (14)
adx.how: Below 20 = choppy, 20-25 = trend forming, above 25 = strong trend. +DI above -DI means buyers lead.

rsi.name: RSI (14)
rsi.how: Above 55 = buyers in control, below 45 = sellers in control. Above 70 is stretched, below 30 is washed out.

bollinger.name: Bollinger Bands (20, 2)
bollinger.how: Price riding the upper band = strong; lower band = weak. Very narrow bands (squeeze) often come before a big move.

obv.name: OBV vs 20-day EMA
obv.how: OBV adds volume on up days and subtracts it on down days. Above its average and rising = accumulation.

vwap20.name: VWAP-20
vwap20.how: Average price paid over 20 sessions, weighted by volume. Price above it = buyers are in profit.

method.conviction: Directional setups only: (indicators agreeing with the category / 5) x 60 + Jev composite x 40 (halved when Jev disagrees; 20 points when Jev has no view).
method.long_stop: Higher of the structure exit and entry - 2 x ATR14 (scanner rule).
method.targets: T1 = nearest confirmed swing high above entry (or 1.5R if none within 2R), T2 = 2R, T3 = 3R. Bearish setups mirror this with swing lows.
method.hedges: F&O names only. Premiums are Black-Scholes estimates from end-of-day ATM IV and the official lot size.

limitations: End-of-day research, not live quotes and not investment advice. No strategy here is validated as profitable.
Categories describe what price has done; they do not predict that targets will be reached.
Option premiums are model estimates; check the live chain, liquidity and margin before trading.
Short trades are shown only for F&O names; cash shares cannot be shorted overnight.
